audit_logs_actor_identity_check.name: audit_logs_actor_identity_check
audit_logs_actor_identity_check.value: ("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'USER' AND "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'USER' AND "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)

authorization_scopes_target_check.name: authorization_scopes_target_check
authorization_scopes_target_check.value:
(
        ("authorization_scopes"."scope_type" = 'GLOBAL'
          AND "authorization_scopes"."faculty_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."class_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."organizational_unit_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("authorization_scopes"."scope_type" = 'FACULTY'
          AND "authorization_scopes"."faculty_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."class_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."organizational_unit_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("authorization_scopes"."scope_type" = 'CLASS'
          AND "authorization_scopes"."faculty_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."class_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."organizational_unit_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("authorization_scopes"."scope_type" = 'ORGANIZATION'
          AND "authorization_scopes"."faculty_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."class_id" IS NULL
          AND "authorization_scopes"."organizational_unit_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

procedure_versions_publication_check.name: procedure_versions_publication_check
procedure_versions_publication_check.value: (status = 'DRAFT' AND published_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'DRAFT' AND published_at IS NOT NULL)

document_jobs_shape_check.name: document_jobs_shape_check
document_jobs_shape_check.value:
("submission_document_jobs"."format" IN ('DOCX','PDF') AND "submission_document_jobs"."retry_allowance" BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 3 + "submission_document_jobs"."retry_allowance" AND (
    ("submission_document_jobs"."state" = 'PENDING' AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempts" = 0 AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempt_id" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."published_document_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("submission_document_jobs"."state" = 'RUNNING' AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempts" > 0 AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."published_document_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("submission_document_jobs"."state" = 'RETRYABLE' AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempts" > 0 AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."published_document_id" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."error_code" IN ('RENDER_FAILED','CONVERT_FAILED','STORAGE_FAILED','LEASE_EXPIRED')) OR
    ("submission_document_jobs"."state" = 'COMPLETE' AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempts" > 0 AND "submission_document_jobs"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "submission_document_jobs"."published_document_id" IS NOT NULL))) IS TRUE

document_retries_shape_check.name: document_retries_shape_check
document_retries_shape_check.value:
("submission_document_retries"."allowance" >= 1 AND "submission_document_retries"."allowance" <= 3 AND "submission_document_retries"."attempts" = 2 + "submission_document_retries"."allowance"
    AND "submission_document_retries"."reason_code" IN ('RENDERER_FIXED','CONVERTER_FIXED','STORAGE_FIXED','WORKER_RESTARTED')) IS TRUE

documents_shape_check.name: documents_shape_check
documents_shape_check.value:
("submission_documents"."format" IN ('DOCX','PDF') AND "submission_documents"."size" BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216
    AND "submission_documents"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "submission_documents"."storage_key" = "submission_documents"."attempt_id" AND "submission_documents"."status" = 'UNSIGNED_DECLARATION'
    AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."renderer") = 'object' AND "submission_documents"."renderer" ?& ARRAY['version','buildSha256','nodeVersion','icuVersion']
    AND "submission_documents"."renderer" - 'version' - 'buildSha256' - 'nodeVersion' - 'icuVersion' = '{}'::jsonb
    AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."renderer"->'version') = 'string' AND char_length("submission_documents"."renderer"->>'version') BETWEEN 1 AND 200
    AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."renderer"->'buildSha256') = 'string' AND ("submission_documents"."renderer"->>'buildSha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."renderer"->'nodeVersion') = 'string' AND char_length("submission_documents"."renderer"->>'nodeVersion') BETWEEN 1 AND 40
    AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."renderer"->'icuVersion') = 'string' AND char_length("submission_documents"."renderer"->>'icuVersion') BETWEEN 1 AND 40
    AND (("submission_documents"."format" = 'DOCX' AND "submission_documents"."converter" IS NULL AND "submission_documents"."source_docx_sha256" IS NULL) OR
    ("submission_documents"."format" = 'PDF' AND "submission_documents"."source_docx_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "submission_documents"."converter" IS NOT NULL
      AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."converter") = 'object' AND "submission_documents"."converter" ?& ARRAY['version','binarySha256']
      AND "submission_documents"."converter" - 'version' - 'binarySha256' = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."converter"->'version') = 'string'
      AND char_length("submission_documents"."converter"->>'version') BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND jsonb_typeof("submission_documents"."converter"->'binarySha256') = 'string'
      AND ("submission_documents"."converter"->>'binarySha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'))) IS TRUE

submission_events_shape_check.name: submission_events_shape_check
submission_events_shape_check.value: "submission_events"."from_revision" > 0 AND "submission_events"."to_revision" = "submission_events"."from_revision" + 1 AND "submission_events"."action" IN ('SUBMITTED','CLAIMED','SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED','RESUBMITTED','APPROVED','REJECTED','REASSIGNED') AND (("submission_events"."action" IN ('SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED','APPROVED','REJECTED','REASSIGNED') AND "submission_events"."note" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("submission_events"."note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000) OR ("submission_events"."action" IN ('SUBMITTED','CLAIMED','RESUBMITTED') AND "submission_events"."note" IS NULL)) AND (("submission_events"."action" = 'REASSIGNED' AND "submission_events"."from_reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_events"."to_reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_events"."from_reviewer_user_id" <> "submission_events"."to_reviewer_user_id" AND "submission_events"."from_reviewer_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("submission_events"."from_reviewer_name")) > 0 AND "submission_events"."to_reviewer_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("submission_events"."to_reviewer_name")) > 0) OR ("submission_events"."action" <> 'REASSIGNED' AND "submission_events"."from_reviewer_user_id" IS NULL AND "submission_events"."to_reviewer_user_id" IS NULL AND "submission_events"."from_reviewer_name" IS NULL AND "submission_events"."to_reviewer_name" IS NULL))

submission_rounds_template_check.name: submission_rounds_template_check
submission_rounds_template_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."declaration_template") = 'object'
      AND "submission_rounds"."declaration_template" ?& ARRAY['id','sha256','bindingSource']
      AND "submission_rounds"."declaration_template" - 'id' - 'sha256' - 'bindingSource' = '{}'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->'id') = 'string'
      AND ("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->>'id') ~ '^submission-summary-v[1-9][0-9]*$'
      AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->'sha256') = 'string'
      AND ("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->>'sha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->'bindingSource') = 'string'
      AND ("submission_rounds"."declaration_template"->>'bindingSource') IN ('SUBMITTED','LEGACY_V1')

submission_rounds_shape_check.name: submission_rounds_shape_check
submission_rounds_shape_check.value: "submission_rounds"."round_number" > 0 AND "submission_rounds"."source" IN ('LIVE','MIGRATION') AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."values") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."student_snapshot") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("submission_rounds"."files") = 'array'

submissions_state_check.name: submissions_state_check
submissions_state_check.value:
"submissions"."revision" > 0 AND (
        ("submissions"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "submissions"."round_number" = 0 AND "submissions"."last_submitted_at" IS NULL AND "submissions"."decision_at" IS NULL AND "submissions"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "submissions"."processing_unit_id" IS NULL AND "submissions"."designated_reviewer_id" IS NULL AND "submissions"."student_snapshot" IS NULL AND "submissions"."reviewer_user_id" IS NULL AND "submissions"."review_started_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("submissions"."status" = 'SUBMITTED' AND "submissions"."round_number" > 0 AND "submissions"."last_submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."decision_at" IS NULL AND "submissions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."processing_unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."student_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."reviewer_user_id" IS NULL AND "submissions"."review_started_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("submissions"."status" IN ('IN_REVIEW', 'NEEDS_SUPPLEMENT', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND "submissions"."round_number" > 0 AND "submissions"."last_submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."processing_unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."student_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submissions"."reviewer_user_id" <> "submissions"."student_user_id" AND "submissions"."review_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("submissions"."status" IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND "submissions"."decision_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("submissions"."status" IN ('IN_REVIEW','NEEDS_SUPPLEMENT') AND "submissions"."decision_at" IS NULL)))
      )

invitation_delivery_jobs_lock_state_chec.name: invitation_delivery_jobs_lock_state_check
invitation_delivery_jobs_lock_state_chec.value: ("invitation_delivery_jobs"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation_delivery_jobs"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."locked_by" IS NULL)

invitation_delivery_jobs_sent_state_chec.name: invitation_delivery_jobs_sent_state_check
invitation_delivery_jobs_sent_state_chec.value: ("invitation_delivery_jobs"."status" = 'SENT' AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation_delivery_jobs"."status" <> 'SENT' AND "invitation_delivery_jobs"."sent_at" IS NULL)

student_import_previews_lock_state_check.name: student_import_previews_lock_state_check
student_import_previews_lock_state_check.value: ("student_import_previews"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "student_import_previews"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "student_import_previews"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "student_import_previews"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("student_import_previews"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "student_import_previews"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "student_import_previews"."locked_by" IS NULL AND "student_import_previews"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("student_import_previews"."status" = 'CONSUMED' AND "student_import_previews"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "student_import_previews"."locked_by" IS NULL AND "student_import_previews"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

student_import_processing_jobs_lock_stat.name: student_import_processing_jobs_lock_state_check
student_import_processing_jobs_lock_stat.value: ("student_import_processing_jobs"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("student_import_processing_jobs"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."locked_by" IS NULL)

student_import_processing_jobs_result_st.name: student_import_processing_jobs_result_state_check
student_import_processing_jobs_result_st.value: ("student_import_processing_jobs"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."last_error_code" IS NULL) OR ("student_import_processing_jobs"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."preview_id" IS NULL AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."last_error_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("student_import_processing_jobs"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND "student_import_processing_jobs"."preview_id" IS NULL)

user_action_tokens_expiration_policy_che.name: user_action_tokens_expiration_policy_check
user_action_tokens_expiration_policy_che.value:
"user_action_tokens"."expires_at"
      > "user_action_tokens"."created_at"

    AND (
      "user_action_tokens"."purpose"
        <> 'ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION'
      OR
      "user_action_tokens"."expires_at"
        <= "user_action_tokens"."created_at"
          + INTERVAL '72 hours'
    )

    AND (
      "user_action_tokens"."purpose"
        <> 'PASSWORD_RESET'
      OR
      "user_action_tokens"."expires_at"
        <= "user_action_tokens"."created_at"
          + INTERVAL '30 minutes'
    )

user_action_tokens_terminal_state_check.name: user_action_tokens_terminal_state_check
user_action_tokens_terminal_state_check.value:
NOT (
            "user_action_tokens"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "user_action_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
